# ECRI

> ECRI is an independent nonprofit organization dedicated to improving healthcare safety, quality, and cost-effectiveness through evidence-based solutions, device evaluation, and patient safety consulting.

ECRI provides comprehensive healthcare solutions across acute care, ambulatory care, senior care, and payer organizations. The organization operates through multiple service lines including ISMP (Institute for Safe Medication Practices), The Just Culture Company, and specialized consulting services focused on medication safety, supply chain optimization, and risk management.

## Key Topics

- Patient Safety
- Medication Safety
- Risk Management
- Device Evaluation
- Supply Chain Optimization
- Healthcare Safety
- ISMP
- Just Culture
- Evidence-based Practice
- Error Reporting
- Adverse Events
- Clinical Evidence
- Systems Thinking
- Human Factors Engineering
- Cost Reduction

## Core Solutions & Services

- [ECRI](https://home.ecri.org): ECRI homepage: Independent nonprofit improving healthcare safety, quality, and cost-effectiveness
- [Independent Device Evaluation | ECRI's Unbiased Insights](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-device-evaluation-lab-and-solutions): ECRI's independent device evaluation lab providing unbiased testing and insights for healthcare
- [Patient Safety Solutions and Services](https://home.ecri.org/pages/patient-safety-advisory-services): SafeSystem Solutions and Enterprise Safety Management for medication and healthcare safety
- [Supply Chain Intelligence | Hospital Supply Chain Solutions | ECRI](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-supply-chain-optimization-solutions): ECRI supply chain optimization with recall management and functional equivalents analytics
- [Education](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-education-and-training-solutions): ECRI education and training on patient safety, root cause analysis, and risk management
- [The Just Culture Company](https://home.ecri.org/pages/the-just-culture-company): Just Culture Company solutions for fair, accountable organizational healthcare cultures

## ISMP - Institute for Safe Medication Practices

- [ISMP](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ismp): ISMP: Institute for Safe Medication Practices advancing medication safety and error reporting
- [Acute Care | ISMP's Expertise in Critical Healthcare](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ismp-acute-care-solutions): ISMP acute care expertise with proactive risk assessments and medication safety consulting
- [ISMP Newsletter Solutions](https://home.ecri.org/pages/newsletter-solutions): ISMP Medication Safety Alert newsletters for healthcare professionals on medication errors
- [Education Solutions | ISMP's Healthcare Learning Resources](https://home.ecri.org/pages/educational-services): ISMP education resources including workshops, webinars, and online learning for medication safety
- [Consulting Solutions | ISMP's Expert Healthcare Guidance](https://home.ecri.org/pages/consulting-services): ISMP consulting services for medication safety, risk assessment, and operational guidance
- [Membership Solutions | ISMP's Tailored Healthcare Safety Plans](https://home.ecri.org/pages/membership-solutions): ISMP membership solutions for medication safety including specialty pharmacy programs

## Healthcare Provider Solutions

- [Acute Care Solutions: Healthcare Guidance & Patient Safety | ECRI](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-acute-care-solutions): ECRI acute care solutions for patient safety, device evaluation, and supply chain optimization
- [Ambulatory Care and Provider Solutions | ECRI](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-ambulatory-care-solutions): ECRI ambulatory care and surgery center solutions including SurgiSmartIQ for cost reduction
- [Comprehensive Solutions for Senior Care Providers I ECRI](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-senior-care-solutions): ECRI senior care solutions for nursing homes and senior living with PSO membership benefits
- [Rural Healthcare](https://home.ecri.org/pages/rural-healthcare): ECRI rural healthcare solutions for chronic disease management and sustainable care delivery

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Medical Liability Insurance for Healthcare Insurers & Providers | ECRI](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-insurer-solutions): ECRI insurer solutions with PSO Intelligence for medical liability and risk mitigation
- [Healthcare Payer Solutions & Services I ECRI](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-healthcare-payers-solutions-and-services): ECRI payer solutions for evidence synthesis, clinical guidelines, and coverage decisions
- [Healthcare Manufacturers: Medical Device Safety & Insights | ECRI](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-manufacturer-solutions): ECRI manufacturer solutions for device safety, market insights, and competitive intelligence
- [Healthcare Government Contracts and Solutions | ECRI](https://home.ecri.org/pages/ecri-government-solutions): ECRI government contracts and consulting for federal healthcare agencies and patient safety
